translation: Not poisonous. It chiefly strengthens sinew and bone, dissipates scroll-form swellings (瘰), red carbuncles, and ulcers of the lower body, (from which) washing brings out worms. Taken by men over a long time, it causes childlessness.
translator_notes: 丈夫久服，令人無子: noted as a cautionary effect of long-term use.
